raw_segments.text: Bloom unjived his crisscrossed hands and with slack fingers plucked the slender cat-gut
While Gooding talked of Baricluff's voice production, while Tom Kernan, harking back
in a retrospective sort of arrangement, talked to listening Father Cowley, who played a voluntary,
While Big Ben Dollard talked with Simon Dedalus, lighting, who nodded as he smoked, who smoked.
